nodes.Name: Finetune
nodes.DocComment:
Finetune is the top-level handler for `gen finetune <subcommand>`.

Subcommands:

	gen finetune export   [--min-success N] [--out path]
	gen finetune modelfile [--base model]   [--out path]
	gen finetune train    [--data path]     [--out path]
	gen finetune stats
